definitions.gradingBasis: Pass/Fail. Three requirements: one written memo per semester, active participation in discussions, and at least three questions per semester in the OB Seminar.
definitions.memo: One written memo per semester: pick one of two options and write a one-page single-spaced answer — (1) review the paper (reject or R&R, with the 2-3 key weaknesses), or (2) outline the next paper you would write building on this research program. Memos are due the Monday before the relevant seminar, by midnight, to the professor via email. You may miss one pre-seminar session per semester with no make-up; if you miss more than one, send an additional memo.
definitions.participation: Come prepared having closely read the speaker's paper. Be ready to discuss: What is the proposed theoretical contribution — novel, interesting, important, well articulated, how could it improve? How well does the empirical evidence support it, and what additional evidence would be useful?
definitions.seminarQuestions: Ask at least three questions each semester during the OB Seminar (Tuesdays 11:35-12:50, right after pre-seminar). For up to two of the three you may email the speaker instead, forwarding the professor.
